     using System;
    using System.Collections.Generic;
    using System.Linq;
    using System.Threading.Tasks;

    namespace UltimateUselessness
    {
        // The core engine of pointlessness
        class Program
        {
            static async Task Main(string[] args)
            {
                var voidManager = new EntropyGenerator();
                await voidManager.ExecutePointlessCycle(3);
            }
        }

        public class EntropyGenerator
        {
            private readonly List<string> _meaninglessData = new List<string>();

            public async Task ExecutePointlessCycle(int iterations)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < iterations; i++)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($"[LOG] Starting existential crisis iteration {i + 1}...");

                    // Constructing a complex string just to ignore it
                    string data = GenerateGarbage(10);
                    _meaninglessData.Add(data);

                    // Simulate "processing" time for a sense of false importance
                    await Task.Delay(500);

                    if (ValidateNothingness(data))
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine("Confirmed: This operation still achieves nothing.");
                    }

                    PerformCircularLogic();
                }

                Console.WriteLine("Finished. The state of the universe remains unchanged.");
            }

            private string GenerateGarbage(int length)
            {
                const string chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789";
                var random = new Random();

                // Using LINQ to make it look sophisticated
                var result = new string(Enumerable.Repeat(chars, length)
                    .Select(s => s[random.Next(s.Length)]).ToArray());

                return $"DUMMY_{result}";
            }

            private bool ValidateNothingness(string input)
            {
                // Checking if a string is a string. Riveting.
                return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(input) && input.GetType() == typeof(string);
            }

            private void PerformCircularLogic()
            {
                int a = 42;
                int b = 7;

                // Math that eventually returns to the starting point
                int result = ((a + b) * 2) / 2 - b;

                if (result == a)
                {
                    // This is always true, yet we check it anyway
                    var shadowVariable = result.ToString();
                    var redundantList = new List<char>();

                    foreach (var c in shadowVariable)
                    {
                        redundantList.Add(c);
                    }

                    redundantList.Clear(); // Farewell, precious data
                }
            }
        }

        public class VoidWrapper
        {
            // A class that wraps a value but offers no way to use it effectively
            public object Content { get; private set; }

            public VoidWrapper(object content)
            {
                Content = content;
            }

            public override string ToString()
            {
                return "I hold secrets that don't matter.";
            }
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace CSVLoadAndStatisticsTest
{
    public partial class Form1 : Form
    {
        // TODO: Change this to your CSV root folder.
        // Expected structure: root\YYYY\MMDD\hhmmssff_Audit.csv
        private const string RootFolder = @"D:\csvroot";

        private CancellationTokenSource _cts;

        public Form1()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        // --------------------------
        // UI Events
        // --------------------------

        private async void btnStart_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            btnStart.Enabled = false;
            btnCancel.Enabled = true;

            if (_cts != null)
            {
                _cts.Cancel();
                _cts.Dispose();
            }
            _cts = new CancellationTokenSource();

            DateTime from = dtpFrom.Value;
            DateTime to = dtpTo.Value;

            try
            {
                // Run aggregation on a background thread, return only results.
                AggregateResult result = await Task.Run(() => ProcessRange(from, to, _cts.Token));

                // Apply results on the UI thread in one shot.
                ApplyResultToUi(result);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                lblStatus.Text = "Canceled.";
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                MessageBox.Show(ex.ToString(), "Error");
            }
            finally
            {
                btnStart.Enabled = true;
                btnCancel.Enabled = false;
            }
        }

        private void btnCancel_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            if (_cts != null) _cts.Cancel();
        }

        private void btnExportDetailsCsv_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // Export detail rows currently displayed (last aggregation result).
            // This sample stores the last result in Tag. You can refactor as needed.
            AggregateResult r = this.Tag as AggregateResult;
            if (r == null || r.Details == null || r.Details.Count == 0)
            {
                MessageBox.Show("No detail data to export.", "Info");
                return;
            }

            using (SaveFileDialog sfd = new SaveFileDialog())
            {
                sfd.Filter = "CSV Files (*.csv)|*.csv|All Files (*.*)|*.*";
                sfd.FileName = "FixesDetails.csv";
                if (sfd.ShowDialog(this) != DialogResult.OK) return;

                try
                {
                    ExportDetailsToCsv(r.Details, sfd.FileName);
                    MessageBox.Show("Export completed.", "Info");
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show(ex.ToString(), "Error");
                }
            }
        }

        // --------------------------
        // Core Aggregation (No UI access)
        // --------------------------

        private AggregateResult ProcessRange(DateTime from, DateTime to, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            AggregateResult result = new AggregateResult();

            foreach (string path in EnumerateTargetAuditCsvFiles(from, to, ct))
            {
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                result.FilesRead++;

                DateTime fileTime;
                if (!TryParseTimeFromAuditFilePath(path, out fileTime))
                {
                    // Skip if file time cannot be determined from path.
                    continue;
                }

                bool firstLine = true;
                int lineNo = 0;

                foreach (string line in File.ReadLines(path))
                {
                    ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                    lineNo++;

                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line))
                        continue;

                    // Spec: 1st line is a datetime text. We skip it for row processing.
                    if (firstLine)
                    {
                        firstLine = false;
                        continue;
                    }

                    result.RowsRead++;

                    // NOTE: If columns may include commas inside quotes, use a real CSV parser.
                    string[] cols = line.Split(',');
                    if (cols.Length < 2)
                        continue;

                    // Expected:
                    // cols[0] = WorkNo (int)
                    // cols[1] = LP or Fix
                    // cols[2] = Fix reason (only for NG) [optional but recommended]
                    // cols[3..] = measurement values (optional)
                    int workNo = 0;
                    int.TryParse(cols[0].Trim(), out workNo);

                    string judge = cols[1].Trim();

                    if (judge.Equals("LP", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        result.OkCount++;

                        // Collect OK measurement statistics (all numeric columns from index 3).
                        AddMeasurementsToStats(cols, startIndex: 3, statsMap: result.OkStatsByIndex);
                    }
                    else if (judge.Equals("Fix", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        result.FixesCount++;

                        string reason = (cols.Length >= 3 ? cols[2].Trim() : "Unknown");
                        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason)) reason = "Unknown";

                        int cnt;
                        if (!result.FixesByReason.TryGetValue(reason, out cnt)) cnt = 0;
                        result.FixesByReason[reason] = cnt + 1;

                        // Collect Fix measurement statistics too (optional).
                        AddMeasurementsToStats(cols, startIndex: 3, statsMap: result.FixesStatsByIndex);

                        // Store detail row for later drill-down / export.
                        FixRecord rec = new FixRecord();
                        rec.Time = fileTime;
                        rec.WorkNo = workNo;
                        rec.Judge = "Fix";
                        rec.Reason = reason;
                        rec.FilePath = path;
                        rec.LineNo = lineNo;
                        rec.RawColumns = cols;

                        result.Details.Add(rec);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // Unknown judge string => skip or treat as needed.
                    }
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static void AddMeasurementsToStats(string[] cols, int startIndex, Dictionary<int, StatisticsAccumulator> statsMap)
        {
            for (int i = startIndex; i < cols.Length; i++)
            {
                double v;
                string s = cols[i].Trim();

                // If your numeric format is stable (e.g., dot decimal), you can force InvariantCulture:
                // double.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out v)
                if (!double.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out v) &&
                    !double.TryParse(s, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out v))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                StatisticsAccumulator acc;
                if (!statsMap.TryGetValue(i, out acc))
                {
                    acc = new StatisticsAccumulator();
                    statsMap[i] = acc;
                }
                acc.Add(v);
            }
        }

        // --------------------------
        // File Enumeration & Time Parsing (Audit naming)
        // --------------------------

        private IEnumerable<string> EnumerateTargetAuditCsvFiles(DateTime from, DateTime to, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            DateTime dayFrom = from.Date;
            DateTime dayTo = to.Date;

            foreach (DateTime day in EachDay(dayFrom, dayTo))
            {
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                string dayFolder = BuildDayFolder(day);
                if (!Directory.Exists(dayFolder))
                    continue;

                // Rename: Inspection -> Audit
                foreach (string file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(dayFolder, "*_Audit.csv", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly))
                {
                    ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                    DateTime fileTime;
                    if (!TryParseTimeFromAuditFilePath(file, out fileTime))
                        continue;

                    if (fileTime >= from && fileTime <= to)
                        yield return file;
                }
            }
        }

        private static IEnumerable<DateTime> EachDay(DateTime from, DateTime to)
        {
            for (DateTime d = from.Date; d <= to.Date; d = d.AddDays(1))
                yield return d;
        }

        private static string BuildDayFolder(DateTime day)
        {
            // root\YYYY\MMDD
            return Path.Combine(
                RootFolder,
                day.Year.ToString("0000"),
                day.ToString("MMdd")
            );
        }

        private static bool TryParseTimeFromAuditFilePath(string filePath, out DateTime dt)
        {
            dt = DateTime.MinValue;

            try
            {
                // Expected: root\YYYY\MMDD\hhmmssff_Audit.csv
                string fileName = Path.GetFileName(filePath);
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName)) return false;

                int underscore = fileName.IndexOf('_');
                if (underscore <= 0) return false;

                string timePart = fileName.Substring(0, underscore); // "hhmmssff"
                if (timePart.Length < 6) return false;

                string folderMMDD = new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetDirectoryName(filePath)).Name; // "MMDD"
                string folderYYYY = new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetDirectoryName(Path.GetDirectoryName(filePath))).Name; // "YYYY"

                int year, month, day;
                if (!int.TryParse(folderYYYY, out year)) return false;
                if (folderMMDD == null || folderMMDD.Length != 4) return false;

                if (!int.TryParse(folderMMDD.Substring(0, 2), out month)) return false;
                if (!int.TryParse(folderMMDD.Substring(2, 2), out day)) return false;

                int hh, mm, ss, ff = 0;
                if (!int.TryParse(timePart.Substring(0, 2), out hh)) return false;
                if (!int.TryParse(timePart.Substring(2, 2), out mm)) return false;
                if (!int.TryParse(timePart.Substring(4, 2), out ss)) return false;

                if (timePart.Length >= 8)
                {
                    int tmp;
                    if (int.TryParse(timePart.Substring(6, 2), out tmp))
                        ff = tmp; // 1/100 sec
                }

                int ms = ff * 10;
                dt = new DateTime(year, month, day, hh, mm, ss, ms);
                return true;
            }
            catch
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        // --------------------------
        // UI Apply (Single shot)
        // --------------------------

        private void ApplyResultToUi(AggregateResult r)
        {
            // Keep last result for export button usage.
            this.Tag = r;

            lblStatus.Text = string.Format("Files={0}, Rows={1}", r.FilesRead, r.RowsRead);
            lblOk.Text = r.OkCount.ToString();
            lblFixes.Text = r.FixesCount.ToString(); // Rename: NGWork -> Fixes

            // Summary by reason (Fixes)
            dgvFixesSummary.Rows.Clear();
            foreach (var kv in r.FixesByReason.OrderByDescending(x => x.Value))
            {
                dgvFixesSummary.Rows.Add(kv.Key, kv.Value);
            }

            // Detail rows (Fix records)
            dgvFixesDetails.Rows.Clear();
            foreach (FixRecord rec in r.Details)
            {
                // Show main fields + optional raw columns join (or pick specific measurement columns).
                string raw = (rec.RawColumns == null) ? "" : string.Join(",", rec.RawColumns);
                dgvFixesDetails.Rows.Add(
                    rec.Time.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff"),
                    rec.WorkNo,
                    rec.Reason,
                    rec.FilePath,
                    rec.LineNo,
                    raw
                );
            }

            // Optional: show one example statistics summary for OK measurement columns
            // (You can bind to another grid if you want.)
            if (r.OkStatsByIndex.Count > 0)
            {
                int firstIndex = r.OkStatsByIndex.Keys.OrderBy(x => x).First();
                StatisticsAccumulator acc = r.OkStatsByIndex[firstIndex];
                if (acc.HasData)
                {
                    lblOkStats.Text = string.Format(
                        "OK Stats (col {0}): avg={1:F3}, min={2:F3}, max={3:F3}, n={4}",
                        firstIndex, acc.Average, acc.Min, acc.Max, acc.Count);
                }
                else
                {
                    lblOkStats.Text = "OK Stats: no numeric data.";
                }
            }
            else
            {
                lblOkStats.Text = "OK Stats: no numeric columns.";
            }
        }

        // --------------------------
        // Export
        // --------------------------

        private static void ExportDetailsToCsv(List<FixRecord> details, string outputPath)
        {
            // Write UTF-8 with BOM to be Excel-friendly (optional).
            using (var sw = new StreamWriter(outputPath, false, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8))
            {
                // Header
                sw.WriteLine("Time,WorkNo,Reason,FilePath,LineNo,RawColumns");

                foreach (FixRecord rec in details)
                {
                    string raw = (rec.RawColumns == null) ? "" : string.Join("|", rec.RawColumns.Select(EscapeCsv));

                    sw.WriteLine(string.Format("{0},{1},{2},{3},{4},{5}",
                        EscapeCsv(rec.Time.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff")),
                        rec.WorkNo,
                        EscapeCsv(rec.Reason),
                        EscapeCsv(rec.FilePath),
                        rec.LineNo,
                        EscapeCsv(raw)
                    ));
                }
            }
        }

        private static string EscapeCsv(string s)
        {
            if (s == null) return "";
            if (s.Contains("\"")) s = s.Replace("\"", "\"\"");
            if (s.Contains(",") || s.Contains("\n") || s.Contains("\r"))
                return "\"" + s + "\"";
            return s;
        }
    }

    // --------------------------
    // Result DTOs
    // --------------------------

    public sealed class AggregateResult
    {
        public int FilesRead { get; set; }
        public int RowsRead { get; set; }

        public int OkCount { get; set; }

        // Rename: NGWork -> Fixes
        public int FixesCount { get; set; }

        // Summary counts by reason
        public Dictionary<string, int> FixesByReason { get; set; }

        // Detail rows (Fixes)
        public List<FixRecord> Details { get; set; }

        // Measurement stats (OK and Fixes) by column index
        public Dictionary<int, StatisticsAccumulator> OkStatsByIndex { get; set; }
        public Dictionary<int, StatisticsAccumulator> FixesStatsByIndex { get; set; }

        public AggregateResult()
        {
            FixesByReason = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            Details = new List<FixRecord>();
            OkStatsByIndex = new Dictionary<int, StatisticsAccumulator>();
            FixesStatsByIndex = new Dictionary<int, StatisticsAccumulator>();
        }
    }

    // Rename: NGWorkRecord -> FixRecord
    public sealed class FixRecord
    {
        public DateTime Time { get; set; }
        public int WorkNo { get; set; }
        public string Judge { get; set; }   // "NG"
        public string Reason { get; set; }
        public string FilePath { get; set; }
        public int LineNo { get; set; }
        public string[] RawColumns { get; set; }
    }

    public sealed class StatisticsAccumulator
    {
        public double Min { get; private set; }
        public double Max { get; private set; }
        public double Sum { get; private set; }
        public int Count { get; private set; }

        public StatisticsAccumulator()
        {
            Min = double.PositiveInfinity;
            Max = double.NegativeInfinity;
            Sum = 0;
            Count = 0;
        }

        public void Add(double value)
        {
            if (value < Min) Min = value;
            if (value > Max) Max = value;
            Sum += value;
            Count++;
        }

        public double Average
        {
            get { return Count == 0 ? 0 : (Sum / Count); }
        }

        public bool HasData
        {
            get { return Count > 0; }
        }
    }
}

        /// <summary>
        /// Check whether the bit at the specified index is set (1) in the given word.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="word">The 16-bit word to inspect.</param>
        /// <param name="bitIndex">Bit index to check (0 = least significant bit).</param>
        /// <returns>True if the bit is set; otherwise false.</returns>
        static bool IsBitOn(ushort word, int bitIndex)
        {
            return ((word >> bitIndex) & 1) == 1;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Determine whether a specific bit transitioned from 0 to 1 between two snapshots.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="prev">Previous word snapshot.</param>
        /// <param name="curr">Current word snapshot.</param>
        /// <param name="bitIndex">Bit index to check for the rising edge (0 = least significant bit).</param>
        /// <returns>True if the bit was 0 in <paramref name="prev"/> and is 1 in <paramref name="curr"/>; otherwise false.</returns>
        static bool IsNewlyOn(ushort prev, ushort curr, int bitIndex)
        {
            ushort newlyOn = (ushort)(curr & ~prev);
            return IsBitOn(newlyOn, bitIndex);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Snapshot of the previous calibration status word. Null indicates no previous snapshot is available.
        /// </summary>
        private ushort? _prevCalibStatus = null;

        /// <summary>
        /// Handle changes in a calibration status word by comparing the current value with the previous snapshot.
        /// Logs events for bits that changed from 0 to 1. After processing, updates the previous snapshot.
        /// Bit meanings (checked in this method):
        /// 0 = calibReady, 1 = calibRunning, 2 = calibSuccess, 3 = calibError,
        /// 4 = calibRequest, 5 = calibZeroAdjust, 6 = calibSpanAdjust, 7 = calibDataSaving.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="curr">Current calibration status word.</param>
        private void HandleCalibrationStatus(ushort curr)
        {
            if (_prevCalibStatus == null)
            {
                // First time, you can't compare, so just keep it
                _prevCalibStatus = curr;
                return;
            }

            ushort prev = _prevCalibStatus.Value;
            ushort newlyOn = (ushort)(curr & ~prev);

            // Are there any new flags
            if (newlyOn != 0)
            {
                if (IsBitOn(newlyOn, 0)) Log("calibReady became ON");
                if (IsBitOn(newlyOn, 1)) Log("calibRunning became ON");
                if (IsBitOn(newlyOn, 2)) Log("calibSuccess became ON");
                if (IsBitOn(newlyOn, 3)) Log("calibError became ON");
                if (IsBitOn(newlyOn, 4)) Log("calibRequest became ON");
                if (IsBitOn(newlyOn, 5)) Log("calibZeroAdjust became ON");
                if (IsBitOn(newlyOn, 6)) Log("calibSpanAdjust became ON");
                if (IsBitOn(newlyOn, 7)) Log("calibDataSaving became ON");
            }

            _prevCalibStatus = curr;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Log which calibration-related flags are currently set in the provided word.
        /// Uses the same bit-to-meaning mapping as HandleCalibrationStatus.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="curr">Current calibration status word to inspect.</param>
        private void LogCurrentFlags(ushort curr)
        {
            if (IsBitOn(curr, 0)) Log("ON: calibReady");
            if (IsBitOn(curr, 1)) Log("ON: calibRunning");
            if (IsBitOn(curr, 2)) Log("ON: calibSuccess");
            if (IsBitOn(curr, 3)) Log("ON: calibError");
            if (IsBitOn(curr, 4)) Log("ON: calibRequest");
            if (IsBitOn(curr, 5)) Log("ON: calibZeroAdjust");
            if (IsBitOn(curr, 6)) Log("ON: calibSpanAdjust");
            if (IsBitOn(curr, 7)) Log("ON: calibDataSaving");
        }

using MicrexSxLoaderCommand.Core.Communication;
using MicrexSxLoaderCommand.Core.Memory;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows.Forms;

namespace MicrexSxLoaderCommand
{
    public partial class MainForm : Form
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Name of the XML address map file located next to the executable.
        /// </summary>
        private readonly string XmlFileName = "AddressMap.xml";

        /// <summary>
        /// TCP server that handles loader commands.
        /// </summary>
        private LoaderCommandTcpServer _server;

        /// <summary>
        /// In-memory representation of PLC WM words.
        /// </summary>
        private PlcMemory _memory = new PlcMemory();

        /// <summary>
        /// Address map model loaded from XML.
        /// </summary>
        private MicrexSxLoaderCommand.Core.AddressMap.AddressMapModel _map;

        /// <summary>
        /// BindingSource for bit rows grid.
        /// </summary>
        private BindingSource _bitsSource = new BindingSource();

        /// <summary>
        /// BindingSource for word rows grid.
        /// </summary>
        private BindingSource _wordsSource = new BindingSource();

        /// <summary>
        /// Rows representing bit items in the grid.
        /// </summary>
        private List<BitRow> _bitRows = new List<BitRow>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Rows representing word items in the grid.
        /// </summary>
        private List<WordRow> _wordRows = new List<WordRow>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Persistence helper for saving/loading simulated state.
        /// </summary>
        private MicrexSxLoaderCommand.Core.Persistence.SimStateStore _stateStore
    = new MicrexSxLoaderCommand.Core.Persistence.SimStateStore();

        /// <summary>
        /// Path of the saved state file.
        /// </summary>
        private string _statePath;



        /// <summary>
        /// Default constructor. Initializes components, server and event handlers.
        /// </summary>
        public MainForm()
        {
            InitializeComponent();

            btnStop.Enabled = false;

            _server = new LoaderCommandTcpServer(_memory);
            _server.Log += OnServerLog;

            // When core memory is updated by network activity, refresh UI grid values safely on the UI thread.
            _server.MemoryUpdated += () =>
            {
                if (IsDisposed) return;
                BeginInvoke(new Action(RefreshGridValues));
            };

        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Refresh displayed Value cells in the grids (bits and words) from PlcMemory.
        /// </summary>
        private void RefreshGridValues()
        {
            // Update bit rows from memory
            for (int i = 0; i < _bitRows.Count; i++)
            {
                var r = _bitRows[i];
                r.Value = ReadBitValue(r.Addr, r.Bit);
            }

            // Update word rows from memory
            for (int i = 0; i < _wordRows.Count; i++)
            {
                var r = _wordRows[i];
                if (r.Type == "DWORD")
                    r.Value = _memory.ReadInt32_LowHigh(r.Addr);   // ★ReadInt32
                else
                    r.Value = _memory.ReadWm(r.Addr);
            }


            _bitsSource.ResetBindings(false);
            _wordsSource.ResetBindings(false);
        }



        /// <summary>
        /// Build grid rows based on the loaded address map model.
        /// </summary>
        private void BuildRowsFromMap()
        {
            _bitRows.Clear();
            _wordRows.Clear();

            // Bit rows
            foreach (var b in _map.Bits)
            {
                _bitRows.Add(new BitRow
                {
                    Group = b.GroupName,
                    Addr = b.WordAddress,
                    Bit = b.BitIndex,
                    Id = b.Id,
                    Description = b.Description,
                    Value = ReadBitValue(b.WordAddress, b.BitIndex)
                });
            }

            // Word rows (WORD + DWORD を表示)
            foreach (var w in _map.Words)
            {
                var t = (w.Type ?? "").Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
                if (t != "WORD" && t != "DWORD")
                    continue;

                int v;
                if (t == "WORD")
                    v = _memory.ReadWm(w.WordAddress);              // ushort → int
                else
                    v = _memory.ReadInt32_LowHigh(w.WordAddress);   // ★ ReadInt32

                _wordRows.Add(new WordRow
                {
                    Addr = w.WordAddress,
                    Id = w.Id,
                    Description = w.Description,
                    Type = t,
                    Value = v
                });
            }


            _bitsSource.DataSource = _bitRows;
            _wordsSource.DataSource = _wordRows;

            dgvBits.AutoGenerateColumns = true;
            dgvWords.AutoGenerateColumns = true;
            dgvBits.DataSource = _bitsSource;
            dgvWords.DataSource = _wordsSource;

            // Adjust column sizing behavior
            //dgvBits.AutoSizeColumnsMode = DataGridViewAutoSizeColumnsMode.AllCells;
            //dgvWords.AutoSizeColumnsMode = DataGridViewAutoSizeColumnsMode.AllCells;

            dgvBits.AutoSizeColumnsMode = DataGridViewAutoSizeColumnsMode.Fill;
            dgvWords.AutoSizeColumnsMode = DataGridViewAutoSizeColumnsMode.Fill;

            // Hide the row header (left-most margin)
            dgvBits.RowHeadersVisible = false;
            dgvWords.RowHeadersVisible = false;

            // Configure column editability so that only the Value column is editable
            SetGridEditability();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Configure per-column editability for DataGridViews: only the "Value" column is editable.
        /// </summary>
        private void SetGridEditability()
        {
            // Bits grid: make DataGridView editable at control level, then lock all columns
            dgvBits.ReadOnly = false; // Keep DataGridView editable so specific columns can be unlocked
            foreach (DataGridViewColumn c in dgvBits.Columns)
            {
                c.ReadOnly = true; // Lock all columns first
            }

            // Allow editing only for the Value column (checkbox)
            var bitsValueCol = dgvBits.Columns.Cast<DataGridViewColumn>()
                .FirstOrDefault(c => c.DataPropertyName == "Value");
            if (bitsValueCol != null)
                bitsValueCol.ReadOnly = false;

            // Words grid
            dgvWords.ReadOnly = false;
            foreach (DataGridViewColumn c in dgvWords.Columns)
            {
                c.ReadOnly = true; // Lock all columns
            }

            // Allow editing only for the Value column (numeric)
            var wordsValueCol = dgvWords.Columns.Cast<DataGridViewColumn>()
                .FirstOrDefault(c => c.DataPropertyName == "Value");
            if (wordsValueCol != null)
                wordsValueCol.ReadOnly = false;

            // Prevent user from adding rows
            dgvBits.AllowUserToAddRows = false;
            dgvWords.AllowUserToAddRows = false;

            // Prevent user from deleting rows
            dgvBits.AllowUserToDeleteRows = false;
            dgvWords.AllowUserToDeleteRows = false;

            dgvBits.EditMode = DataGridViewEditMode.EditOnEnter;
            dgvWords.EditMode = DataGridViewEditMode.EditOnEnter;

        }



        /// <summary>
        /// Read a single bit from a WM word in memory.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="wordAddr">Word address (index).</param>
        /// <param name="bitIndex">Bit index (0..15).</param>
        /// <returns>True when the bit is set; otherwise false.</returns>
        private bool ReadBitValue(int wordAddr, int bitIndex)
        {
            ushort word = _memory.ReadWm(wordAddr);
            int mask = 1 << bitIndex;
            return (word & mask) != 0;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Save simulated state and dispose server when the form is closing.
        /// </summary>
        private void MainForm_FormClosing(object sender, FormClosingEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_statePath))
                    _statePath = _stateStore.GetDefaultPath();

                var snap = _memory.GetWmSnapshot();
                _stateStore.Save(_statePath, snap);

                AppendLog("[STATE] Saved: " + _statePath);

                _server?.Dispose();

        /// <summary>
        /// Handler for server log events. Routes messages to the UI logger.
        /// </summary>
        private void OnServerLog(string message)
        {
            // Server events may arrive on a non-UI thread, so append via UI-safe helper
            AppendLog(message);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Append a line to the UI log textbox in a thread-safe manner.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="text">Text to append.</param>
        private void AppendLog(string text)
        {
            if (this.IsDisposed) return;

            if (txtLog.InvokeRequired)
            {
                txtLog.BeginInvoke(new Action(() => AppendLog(text)));
                return;
            }

            txtLog.AppendText(text + Environment.NewLine);
        }


        private void dgvWords_CellEndEdit(object sender, DataGridViewCellEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.RowIndex < 0) return;

            var col = dgvWords.Columns[e.ColumnIndex];
            if (col == null || col.DataPropertyName != "Value") return;

            var row = _wordRows[e.RowIndex];

            // Re-read cell value from grid (it may be boxed as object)
            object cellValue = dgvWords.Rows[e.RowIndex].Cells[e.ColumnIndex].Value;

            int newValue;
            if (!TryParseInt32(cellValue, out newValue))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("Please enter a valid integer value.");
                dgvWords.Rows[e.RowIndex].Cells[e.ColumnIndex].Value = row.Value;
                return;
            }

            if (row.Type == "WORD")
            {
                if (newValue < 0 || newValue > 65535)
                {
                    MessageBox.Show("WORD must be between 0 and 65535.");
                    dgvWords.Rows[e.RowIndex].Cells[e.ColumnIndex].Value = row.Value;
                    return;
                }

                row.Value = newValue;
                _memory.WriteWm(row.Addr, (ushort)newValue);                 // WORD書き込み
                AppendLog($"[UI] WORD set addr={row.Addr} => {newValue} (0x{newValue:X4})");
            }
            else // DWORD
            {
                row.Value = newValue;
                _memory.WriteInt32_LowHigh(row.Addr, newValue);              // ★ここで WriteInt32
                AppendLog($"[UI] DWORD set addr={row.Addr} => {newValue}");
            }

            RefreshGridValues();

        }

        //new method
        private bool TryParseInt32(object value, out int result)
        {
            result = 0;
            if (value == null) return false;

            if (value is int)
            {
                result = (int)value;
                return true;
            }

            var s = value.ToString();
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)) return false;

            return int.TryParse(s.Trim(), out result);
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Try to parse an object value into ushort. Accepts ushort directly or decimal string.
        /// </summary>
        private bool TryParseUShort(object value, out ushort result)
        {
            result = 0;
            if (value == null) return false;

            // If it's already ushort
            if (value is ushort)
            {
                result = (ushort)value;
                return true;
            }

            // Try string representation
            var s = value.ToString();
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)) return false;

            // Allow decimal only (0xFFFF hex could be added later)
            int n;
            if (!int.TryParse(s.Trim(), out n)) return false;
            if (n < 0 || n > 65535) return false;

            result = (ushort)n;
            return true;
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Represents a row in the bit grid.
        /// </summary>
        public sealed class BitRow
        {
            public string Group { get; set; }
            public int Addr { get; set; }
            public int Bit { get; set; }
            public string Id { get; set; }
            public string Description { get; set; }

            /// <summary>
            /// Current boolean value for UI display.
            /// </summary>
            public bool Value { get; set; }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Represents a row in the word grid.
        /// </summary>
        public sealed class WordRow
        {
            public int Addr { get; set; }
            public string Id { get; set; }
            public string Description { get; set; }

            public string Type { get; set; }            //Add
            /// <summary>
            /// Current ushort value for UI display.
            /// </summary>
            public int Value { get; set; }              //ushort 2 int
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Form load handler: load XML map, restore saved state, build grids and attach UI events.
        /// </summary>
        private void MainForm_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                // 1) Load XML address map definition
                LoadXML();

                // 2) Determine default path for state file
                _statePath = _stateStore.GetDefaultPath();

                // 3) Load JSON saved state and restore into PlcMemory
                try
                {
                    var snap = _stateStore.Load(_statePath);
                    _memory.LoadWmSnapshot(snap);
                    AppendLog("[STATE] Loaded: " + _statePath);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    AppendLog("[STATE] Load ERROR: " + ex.Message);
                }

                // 4) Build grid rows from address map (memory already restored so values reflect saved state)
                BuildRowsFromMap();
                RefreshGridValues();

                // 5) Attach grid event handlers after initial render to avoid spurious events during startup
                dgvBits.CurrentCellDirtyStateChanged += dgvBits_CurrentCellDirtyStateChanged;
                dgvBits.CellValueChanged += dgvBits_CellValueChanged;
                dgvWords.CellEndEdit += dgvWords_CellEndEdit;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                AppendLog("Load ERROR: " + ex.Message);
            }
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Load address map XML from the executable directory.
        /// </summary>
        private void LoadXML()
        {
            try
            {
                string baseDir = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory; // location of the executable
                string xmlPath = Path.Combine(baseDir, XmlFileName);

                var loader = new MicrexSxLoaderCommand.Core.AddressMap.AddressMapXmlLoader();
                _map = loader.LoadFromFile(xmlPath);

                AppendLog(string.Format("AddressMap loaded. Bits={0}, Words={1}", _map.Bits.Count, _map.Words.Count));

            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                AppendLog("XML Load ERROR: " + ex.Message);
            }
        }


        private void dgvBits_CurrentCellDirtyStateChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            // Commit checkbox changes immediately so CellValueChanged fires right away
            if (dgvBits.IsCurrentCellDirty)
            {
                dgvBits.CommitEdit(DataGridViewDataErrorContexts.Commit);
            }
        }

        private void dgvBits_CellValueChanged(object sender, DataGridViewCellEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.RowIndex < 0) return;

            // Only handle changes to the Value column (auto-generated column name is "Value")
            var col = dgvBits.Columns[e.ColumnIndex];
            if (col == null || col.DataPropertyName != "Value") return;

            var row = _bitRows[e.RowIndex];
            WriteBitValue(row.Addr, row.Bit, row.Value);

            AppendLog(string.Format("[UI] BIT set addr={0} bit={1} => {2}", row.Addr, row.Bit, row.Value));
            RefreshGridValues();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Write a single bit in the specified WM word address.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="wordAddr">Word address (index).</param>
        /// <param name="bitIndex">Bit index (0..15).</param>
        /// <param name="on">True to set the bit; false to clear it.</param>
        private void WriteBitValue(int wordAddr, int bitIndex, bool on)
        {
            ushort word = _memory.ReadWm(wordAddr);
            int mask = 1 << bitIndex;

            ushort newWord;
            if (on)
                newWord = (ushort)(word | mask);
            else
                newWord = (ushort)(word & ~mask);

            _memory.WriteWm(wordAddr, newWord);
        }
    }

docs.title: クローン（リモートからコピーを作る）
docs.text:
git clone git@server:/path/to/repo.git

実行後、repo というフォルダが作成され、その中にリポジトリの内容がコピーされます

docs.title: 既存のブランチを見る
docs.text: git branch # ローカルのブランチ git branch -r # リモートのブランチ

docs.title: 既存のリモートブランチに切り替える場合
ステージに追加（追跡対象に）
docs.text: git add main.cpp # 個別に追加 git add . # 全部まとめて追加

docs.title: コミット（ローカル履歴に記録）
docs.text: git commit -m "機能追加: メイン処理を実装"

docs.title: 最新の情報だけ反映（安全）
docs.text:
git fetch --prune --tags

--prune：リモートで削除されたブランチの追跡ブランチ（例：origin/old-feature）をローカルからも掃除します --tags：すべてのタグを取得します

git log --oneline --graph --decorate --all

「hogeブランチ が main にマージ済みかどうか」の判定方法 その中に「Merge branch 'feature/hoge'」といったメッセージがあれば、マージ済み

git log main --merges --oneline

「現在いるローカルブランチ」と「origin/main」のファイル差分を表示

git diff origin/main

docs.title: リモートにプッシュ（アップロード）
docs.text:
git push origin your-branch-name origin：リモートリポジトリの名前（通常は origin のまま）

上流（upstream）が未設定の場合

The current branch hoge has no upstream branch.

のようなエラーが出る → 一度でも上流設定を済ませれば、その後は git push だけでOK

git push -u origin your-branch-name

あるいは

git push -u origin HEAD # 今いるブランチ名を自動で使う

docs.title: 2回目以降
docs.text: git push # もう -u は不要。普通に通る git pull --rebase # 追従時

docs.title: 他の人の更新を取り込む（プル）
マージ
docs.text:
例: feature ブランチを main に取り込む(featureが消えてmainが残る) git checkout main git merge feature

※リモートの最新状態を知りたいなら、まず git fetch が必要

docs.title: git fetch
docs.text: リモートの最新状況を取得してローカルに記録するだけ（作業中ブランチは一切触らない） リモート追跡ブランチ（例：origin/main, origin/feature/hoge）が更新される ワーキングツリー/現在のブランチは変化なし 安全に「最新を観察」できる

docs.title: git pull
docs.text: = git fetch ＋ 現在のブランチを更新（マージ or リベース） デフォルトは fetch後に「マージ」 設定しだいで fetch後に「リベース」 へ変更可能 作業中のブランチに変更が入りうる（コンフリクトも起きうる） git pull は「現在のブランチ」しか更新しない

docs.title: まとめ
docs.text:
# 1. 最新のリモート情報を取る
git fetch --prune --tags

# 2. main を最新化
git switch main
git pull --rebase   # main を origin/main に追従

# 3. 再び hoge ブランチに戻る
git switch feature/hoge

# 4. main の最新を取り込む（リベース推奨）
git rebase main
# or マージする場合は: git merge main

# 5. リモートに更新を反映
git push --force-with-lease   # rebase したなら必須
# or
git push                      # merge したならこれでOK
